integrity: Exhaustive 16-vertex subset enumeration, complete signed integer unit reductions and independent depth-first-search face verification are provided as standalone scripts. Scientific self-review only.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the degree-two vertex-forest stage and its inclusion into the unrestricted forest complex of the four-cube. Only terminal rational homology and rational inclusion rank are asserted; no odd-torsion, full terminal homotopy, or higher-cube formula is claimed.
title: A 129-sphere forest stage and nine surviving homology classes of the four-cube
